title: Juicy British Russet Potato Gratin
description: A rich and creamy British dish featuring russet potatoes in a pungent and silky gratin, perfect for special occasions, this recipe is ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly as it avoids overly stimulating ingredients and emphasizes nourishing, wholesome foods.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the sliced potatoes and melted butter, tossing to coat.
In a separate bowl, mix together the minced garlic, shredded gruyere cheese, heavy cream, salt, black pepper, and chopped thyme.
In a greased 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of potatoes.
Pour some of the garlic and cheese mixture over the potatoes, then repeat this process until all ingredients are used, ending with a layer of cheese on top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the potatoes are tender.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
